title: Path Traversal via Unsanitized File Parameter in loadStaticData
description: The loadStaticData function accepts a string argument `file` from callers outside this module and concatenates it directly into a path resolve operation without sanitizing path traversal sequences (e.g., `../`). An attacker capable of influencing the `file` parameter could traverse out of the intended `./data/static/` directory and read arbitrary `.yml` files across the filesystem.

trace.description: The function loadStaticData accepts an untrusted file parameter from external callers.

path.resolve constructs filePath by concatenating './data/static/' with user input without stripping directory traversal characters or verifying that the resolved path stays within the base directory.
The contents of the traversed file are parsed by safeLoad and returned to the caller.
readFile reads content from the arbitrarily resolved file path on disk.

title: Unrestricted Application Configuration Retrieval via Cypress Task
description: The Cypress task 'GetFromConfig' accepts an arbitrary configuration variable name and directly queries application configuration via 'config.get(variable)'. Because no restriction or key filtering is applied, callers of this Cypress task can read sensitive application secrets and configuration values (such as database credentials or JWT secrets).

trace.description: The 'GetFromConfig' Cypress task function receives an arbitrary 'variable' parameter.
Calls 'config.get(variable)' to return arbitrary configuration data without validation or key restrictions.

title: Unvalidated Deserialization of LocalStorage Data
description: The `getAll` method reads raw values from `localStorage` and directly parses them using `JSON.parse` without `try...catch` block handling or structural schema validation. Client-side local storage can be modified by third-party scripts, browser extensions, or XSS vectors. Unhandled malformed JSON or unexpected object payloads can crash the service or introduce unexpected object state into application logic.

Deserializes untrusted storage payload via JSON.parse without error handling or integrity checks.

title: Use of Cryptographically Weak PRNG for ID Generation
description: The `generateId` method relies on `Math.random()` to generate random characters for conversation identifiers. `Math.random()` is not cryptographically secure and produces predictable outputs once sufficient outputs are observed, making conversation IDs guessable.

trace.description: generateId function called to produce a unique identifier for stored conversation.
